prompt:
A high-fidelity flat UI design mockup of a desktop web application screen, rendered straight-on with no perspective, no device frame, no hands, no room. This is a screen design, not a photograph or poster.

LAYOUT SKELETON, top to bottom, stated literally:

1. A full-width horizontal navigation beam, 56px tall, solid near-black carbon (#17161a). At its left, the wordmark "PLIA" in condensed uppercase sans. Beside it three small uppercase navigation labels: "TABLEAU DE BORD", "TRANSACTIONS", "HISTORIQUE" — the last one underlined with a 2px red rule. At its right, two small line icons and a circular avatar initial.

2. Below the beam, on a warm light concrete-grey page ground (#e6e3df) with a faint concrete grain: a row of three small square account tabs with 45-degree cut corners, then a horizontal month-range strip of small month chips reading "JUIN JUILLET AOÛT SEPT OCT NOV", two of them filled black.

3. THE MAIN ELEMENT, occupying three quarters of the screen: ONE single wide data table on a light plate (#eeece8) whose four corners are cut at 45 degrees. Its structure:
   - A single wide sticky left spine column, roughly 280px, holding section titles and expense category names in condensed sans, each with a small arrow icon and a tiny uppercase letterspaced monospace duration label beneath it. Names read: "Salaire", "Loyer", "Assurance", "Courses", "Essence", "Sorties", "Abonnements", "Vacances".
   - To the right of the spine, THREE month blocks side by side, separated by a strong 1px vertical hairline and a wide gutter. Each block is headed by a centred month name in condensed sans ("JUILLET", "AOÛT", "SEPTEMBRE") with the year "2026" beside it in small monospace, and beneath the name a row of six tiny uppercase letterspaced monospace column labels: "BUDGET  DÉPENSÉ  BALANCE  RÉEL  PRÉVU  SI DÉP."
   - Rows organised into labelled horizontal bands: a band headed "CE QUI RENTRE" on a very faint carbon wash, then "DÉPENSES PRÉVUES" and "DÉPENSES NON PRÉVUES" on a faint red wash, then "PAS ENCORE RANGÉ", and at the bottom three heavy total rows on a much darker carbon wash reading "TOTAL DU MOIS", "SOLDE DE FIN DE MOIS", "TOTAL DÉPASSEMENT".
   - Every number is monospace, tabular, right-aligned, in the format "1 830,20 €". Three or four numbers are red (#b31d25) to mark negatives. One row carries a small solid black pill chip with tiny white uppercase text reading "DÉPASSEMENT".

VISUAL WORLD, fixed and non-negotiable: absolutely no rounded corners anywhere; every panel corner is cut at 45 degrees. No drop shadows, no gradients, no glass, no glow. Depth comes only from 1px hairline rules (#c7c3bd) and flat tonal washes. Palette strictly: warm concrete grey ground, lighter plate, near-black carbon ink, mid grey #6b6966 for labels, and exactly one accent, a signal red #d7262e, used only for negative amounts and overspend marks. No green, no amber, no blue. Typography: a condensed grotesque sans for names and headings, a monospace face for every single number and every tiny uppercase label. No charts, no pie graphs, no gauges, no sparklines, no illustrations, no icons beyond thin line arrows and chevrons. Matte, precise, engineering-drawing calm.
